name: thoughtloop
description: A cohesive, composable Codex skill pack with one adaptive graph, shared evidence contracts, and independent capability nodes.

interface.longDescription: A cohesive Codex skill pack with one adaptive orchestrator, reusable discovery, investigation, decision, execution, verification, review, handoff, and writing nodes, shared observable contracts, and bounded fresh-context subagents when the accuracy benefit justifies the cost.
defaultPrompt: Use ThoughtLoop to explore important alternatives, make the change, and prove the result.
Use ThoughtLoop with bounded subagents to investigate and review this task.
